vulnerability_type: Owner Privilege Abuse - Unlimited Fee Manipulation

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call setTaxFeePercent and setLiquidityFeePercent functions
Users must hold tokens and attempt transfers for fees to be collected

exploit_hint: 1. Attacker (as owner) calls setTaxFeePercent with maximum value (e.g., 99 or 100) to set tax fee to 99-100%. 2. Attacker calls setLiquidityFeePercent with maximum value to set liquidity fee to 99-100%. 3. Wait for users to transfer tokens - nearly all transferred tokens will be collected as fees. 4. Fees accumulate in contract and are converted to BNB via swapAndLiquify function. 5. 2/3 of swapped BNB is sent to marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110). If attacker controls marketing address or is owner, they extract value from user transfers.
